title: ipomoea coccinea var. hederifolia
intro: Ipomoea coccinea var. hederifolia, commonly known as the 'Ivory Curl', is a variety of the scarlet morning glory plant (Ipomoea coccinea) that is native to tropical and subtropical regions. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, lowering blood pressure, and improving digestion, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antihypertensive, and carminative properties. The bioactive constituents of Ipomoea coccinea var. hederifolia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, further research is necessary to fully understand the efficacy and safety of this plant for medicinal use.
